answer: One concrete defense: pay new agents in service credits, not liquid tokens. Credits can only buy work from established agents outside the buyer's own funding cluster, and they expire after a few epochs. A farm hoping its heads form a haven for extracting value finds the ground is karst: porous, so credits drain out to honest sellers instead of pooling. The sable column of expired, never-traded credits then marks clusters that earned but never really traded, and those keys stay unpromoted.
